standards.summaryText: Investigate and describe relationships between humans and their environments, and identify related issues and scientific questions
standards.officialOutcomeText: Investigate and describe relationships between humans and their environments, and identify related issues and scientific questions
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explore and explain relationships between humans and their environments, and recognize related issues and scientific questions.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 1

standards.summaryText: Trace and interpret the flow of energy and materials within an ecosystem
standards.officialOutcomeText: Trace and interpret the flow of energy and materials within an ecosystem
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students map and explain the flow of energy and materials within an ecosystem.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 2

standards.summaryText: Monitor a local environment, and assess the impacts of environmental factors on the growth, health and reproduction of organisms in that environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: Monitor a local environment, and assess the impacts of environmental factors on the growth, health and reproduction of organisms in that environment
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students observe over time a local environment, and evaluate the impacts of environmental factors on the growth, health and reproduction of organisms in that environment.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 3

standards.summaryText: Describe the relationships among knowledge, decisions and actions in maintaining life-supporting environments
standards.officialOutcomeText: Describe the relationships among knowledge, decisions and actions in maintaining life-supporting environments
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explain the relationships among knowledge, decisions and actions in maintaining life-supporting environments.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 4

standards.summaryText: Ask questions about the relationships between and among observable variables, and plan investigations to address those questions
standards.officialOutcomeText: Ask questions about the relationships between and among observable variables, and plan investigations to address those questions
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build initiating and planning science skills by asking questions about the relationships between and among observable variables, and plan investigations to address those questions.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Conduct investigations into the relationships between and among observations, and gather and record qualitative and quantitative data
standards.officialOutcomeText: Conduct investigations into the relationships between and among observations, and gather and record qualitative and quantitative data
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build performing and recording science skills by conducting investigations into the relationships between and among observations, and gather and record qualitative and quantitative data.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and develop and assess possible explanations
standards.officialOutcomeText: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and develop and assess possible explanations
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build analyzing and interpreting science skills by analyzing qualitative and quantitative data, and develop and evaluate possible explanations.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Work collaboratively on problems; and use appropriate language and formats to communicate ideas, procedures and results
standards.officialOutcomeText: Work collaboratively on problems; and use appropriate language and formats to communicate ideas, procedures and results
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build communication and teamwork science skills by collaborating on problems; and use appropriate language and formats to communicate ideas, procedures and results.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN7 > Unit A: Interactions and Ecosystems > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Show interest in science-related questions and issues, and pursue personal interests and career possibilities within science-related fields (e.g., take an interest in media reports on environmental issues, and seek out further information; express an interest in conducting scientific investigations of their own design; develop an interest in careers related to environmental sciences)
standards.officialOutcomeText: Show interest in science-related questions and issues, and pursue personal interests and career possibilities within science-related fields (e.g., take an interest in media reports on environmental issues, and seek out further information; express an interest in conducting scientific investigations of their own design; develop an interest in careers related to environmental sciences)
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students develop science learning dispositions by engaging with science-related questions and issues, and pursue personal interests and career possibilities within science-related fields.
